Skulpt browser interpreter, vendored from skulpt/skulpt-dist at 1473759236009587a04bd9875c7afd812d9f02d2.
Source: https://github.com/skulpt/skulpt-dist/blob/1473759236009587a04bd9875c7afd812d9f02d2/skulpt.min.js

skulpt-stdlib.js is a subset extracted from that same revision: src/builtin/sys.js, src/lib/math.js and src/lib/random.js. All other standard library files are omitted. pygame.py is our Canvas adapter. No WASM runtime or remote assets are loaded.
